scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n public-web,admin-web,mobile,api -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:public-web" "npm:dev:admin-web" "npm:dev:mobile" "npm:dev:api"
scripts.build:libs: ng build design-tokens && ng build design-system && ng build shared-models && ng build api-client && ng build realtime-client
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && ng build public-web && ng build admin-web && ng build mobile && npm run build:api
scripts.build:public-web: npm run build:libs && ng build public-web
scripts.build:admin-web: npm run build:libs && ng build admin-web
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:libs && ng build mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && ng test design-tokens --watch=false && ng test design-system --watch=false && ng test api-client --watch=false && ng test realtime-client --watch=false && ng test public-web --watch=false && ng test admin-web --watch=false && ng test mobile --watch=false && npm run test:api
scripts.test:public-web: npm run build:libs && ng test public-web --watch=false
scripts.test:admin-web: npm run build:libs && ng test admin-web --watch=false
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build:libs && ng test mobile --watch=false
scripts.test:design-system: npm run build:libs && ng test design-system --watch=false
scripts.test:api-client: npm run build:libs && ng test api-client --watch=false
scripts.lint: ng lint public-web && ng lint admin-web && ng lint mobile && ng lint design-tokens && ng lint design-system && ng lint shared-models && ng lint api-client && ng lint realtime-client && npm run lint:api
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
